name: Soul Channeller (Astradhari Archetype)
body:
For most veilweavers and starcallers, the way astradhari summon veils and constellations is an enigma. This is exacerbated by the fact that they don’t share a common, unified, way to do so.

Sometimes, even the abilities of two astradharis are fundamentally different from one another. Soul channellers are one example of this. Instead of summoning combat knowledge from the plane of memory, these individuals allow part of the original bearer’s soul to manifest through them.

Force of Personality

Soul channellers use their Charisma modifier for any astradhari class features that are normally based on Intelligence.

Soul channel (Su)

At 2nd level, a soul channeller choses a soul from the soulforge list for each of their astras. When they gain access to a new astra, they choose a soul as part of the learning process. Whenever a soul channeller designates their chosen astra, they gain all the benefits of the chosen soul as a soulforge of their class level using the soul forging ability. Once chosen, the soul chosen for an astra cannot be changed. When channeled, the soul temporarily takes the shape of a ghostly image behind the soul channellers that mimics their actions.

A soul channeller can only benefit from one channeled soul at a time. This replaces akashic style.

Soul Veils (Su)

Instead of learning akashic feats, soul channellers gain modest veilweaving abilities. At 3rd level, and again at 11th and 19th levels, when a soul channeller designates their chosen astra, they can also shape a non-enhanced veil from the list associated with the soul tied to the astra, and they remain shaped for as long as the astra is summoned. Any essence invested in the astra also empowers the veils. At 7th level, they learn how to bind their veils to any of the lesser chakras (Hands, Head or Feet). At 15th level, they learn how to bind their veils to any of the middle chakras (Headband, Shoulders or Wrists). This ability replaces akashic feats.
